scientific_integrity: The alternating digit characterization is attributed to Straub, Amdeberhan and Moll (2008). The specific multiplicative intersections and their collapse are proved separately. Finite checks are not substituted for infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact at prime five for three-central binomial coefficients and ratios two and three; index digit sets only. Other primes and multipliers not classified, priority risks remain.
title: Sharp multiplicative-orbit collapse for five-nondivisible three-central binomial coefficients
